mapper.select: select * from checklist_type where user_id = #{userId} order by id
select * from checklist_type where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into checklist_type (name, parentid, color, user_id) values (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{color}, #{userId})
mapper.update: update checklist_type set name = #{name}, parentid = #{parentId}, color = #{color} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from checklist_type where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
